title: Notification Triage
task_prompt:
## task_009: Downstream Candidate -- Notification Triage

Draft a concise morning work-start note to myself with two sections: preparation for the Team Standup (Q3 Planning focus) and priority email follow-ups. Strictly exclude personal, health, financial, or system notifications. Keep the tone natural and conversational, suitable for a quick personal briefing.
answer:
## Preparation for the Team Standup — Q3 Planning
- Revisit the Q3 priorities: keep the highest-impact launch and platform-stability work visible, and clarify any resource trade-offs.
- Bring an update on the in-progress Q2 project proposal and confirm whether it affects Q3 sequencing or staffing.
- Make sure the presentation slides for the team meeting are moving along and flag any decisions or blockers that need group input.

## Priority email follow-ups
- **Q3 Budget Review — Action Required:** Review the travel allocations and confirm the highlighted discrepancies to Michael by EOD.
- **Project Phoenix Deadline Update:** Check the revised JIRA tickets and notify stakeholders about any potential blockers.
